findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A).

On arrival the PIC was unaware of any reporting agreements or similar paperwork that had been filled out or signed by food handlers. The PIC called the food manager who stated correct procedures but stated that they had not known that verification/paperwork was required. Blank copies were found in the public health folder in the filing cabinet. Fresh copies of the SCDPH reporting agreements were given during this inspection and a follow up scheduled for 10 days to ensure compliance with the code. Ensure that all needed paperwork is available at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment:
(REREAT) 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use.

On arrival the hand sink next to the three part sink is observed blocked with a hand cart. As the inspector and PIC walked into the space the PIC moved the cart into the walk in cooler prior to inspector prompting. This shows that they know that it should not be in this location normally. The situation was discussed with the PIC during this inspection. Ensure that all hand sinks remain accessible at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. 

On arrival there was no soap available for use at the hand sink next to the three part sink. Soap was provided to correct. Ensure that all hand sinks are properly supplied at all times.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. 

On arrival the hand sink in the back of the facility was blocked by a cart. When discussed, the PIC indicated that they used the hand sink in the front when needed. This is too far for when dishes are being cleaned. This was stated and the cart moved to correct. Ensure that all hand sinks are maintained accessible at all times to facilitate consistent use.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: (A) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be: (C) Cleaned at least every 4 hours. 

Rollers used for tornados are observed soiled during this inspection. Service had been halted prior to this inspection and these should have been cleaned at that time. They were cleaned during this inspection to correct the violation. Ensure that the food contact surfaces are cleaned at the end of shift each day.
